question: Can a single reduced amplitude of the existing conservative angular route preserve its smooth MACS1931 position benefit without creating the extra root pairs in families 2 and 3?

selection_rules.baseline_topology: the seven-family global root-count vector at eta=0 after its own exact geometry refit
selection_rules.subcritical: the eta formula retains the eta=0 root count in every family and does not increase potentially observable surplus roots
selection_rules.primary_accuracy: equal-family RMS of global one-to-one assigned image distances among families with every image assigned
selection_rules.secondary_accuracy: held-out observed-seed exact-root RMS and convergence, reported without rewarding an unsupported extra pair
selection_rules.descriptive_survivor: among subcritical eta values, lowest primary accuracy RMS; no promotion because eta is selected on spent MACS1931

claim_limits: Eta is selected on spent MACS1931 and cannot be called universal without frozen transfer.
The scan changes only angular-route amplitude; it does not exhaust route shape or covariant completions.
The lens remains simplified and many exact geometry fits can touch nuisance bounds.
Root detectability uses a relative-magnification screen rather than calibrated multiband completeness.
